message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, white, serif letters across the top. Below this, "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is written in small, black letters. A red, cursive word, "Timah," is superimposed on the right side of the main title. 

The background shows a building with large glass windows and various shop signs. In the foreground, rolls of silver barbed wire stretch across a paved area. Below the main title, the headline "TIM MAWAR DAN RUSUH SARINAH" is written in large, white, bold, sans-serif block letters. Smaller black text below it says, "Polisi menengarai keterlibatan penculik aktivis 1998 dalam huru-hara 22 Mei lalu. Kesaksian pelaku lapangan."

The lower half features a scene of wreckage. A motorcycle with a black frame and silver exhaust pipe lies on its side in the lower foreground. A green helmet sits on the ground nearby. To the left, the front wheel and red rim of another motorcycle are visible. Several red plastic barriers and concrete blocks with yellow paint are scattered around. Debris, including plastic bottles, lies on the ground. At the top left, text reads "DARI JAKARTA MENJERAT SJAMSUL NURSALIM." At the top right, "SIAPA PENEMBAK KORBAN AMUK MASSA?" is written. A barcode and the date "10-16 JUNI 2019" are at the bottom right.
